questions.markdown:
500kg of wet steam at a pressure of 0.6 MPa is generated in a boiler per hour. The temperature of feed water is 20$^{\circ}$C and the total amount of heat added in the boiler is 1236MJ/h. The steam from the boiler enters the super heater after a heat loss of 300kJ/kg, where its temperature is to be raised to 200$^{\circ}$C. Determine

(i) Dryness fraction of the steam at the entry point of the super heater?

(ii) Heat absorbed per hour in the super heater?

A gas-fired boiler produces superheated steam at 100 bar from feedwater at 45 $^{\circ}$C, with a steam flow rate of 12 kg/s. Fuel gas is burned at a rate of 1.5 tons per hour, having a GCV of 46 MJ/kg, and the boiler efficiency is 88%. Find the condition of steam produced.

Classify boilers based on the following criteria:

i) Flow of water and hot gases

ii) Circulation of water

iii) Axis of the shell

Power is transmitted between two shafts, 4 meters apart, using two pulleys, both rotating in counterclockwise directions, with a velocity ratio of unity. The length of the belt is 11.142m, and the coefficient of friction is 0.3. Determine the size of the two pulleys and the tensions on both sides of the belt drive if the initial tension is 0.75KN.

A simple gear train as shown in Figure, has four gears namely A, B, C and D. Gear A is driver gear and D gear is driven gear. Gears B and C are intermediate gears. Driving gear A rotates anticlockwise direction with a speed of 300 rpm. The number of teeth on gears A, B, C and D are 30, 90, 60 and 120, respectively. Determine

(i) the speed of the driven gear, and (ii) the speed of rotations of intermediate gears, (iii) the velocity ratio of gear trains.

questions.markdown: Illustrating thermodynamic events explain working of an IC engine that directly admits the charge and operates with a compression ratio of 9:1.

The following observations were recorded during a test on an IC engine. Net load on the brake drum = 36kg, Cam Shaft Speed= 250 rpm, Fuel consumption= 0.003kg/sec, Diameter of the brake drum = 2m, Calorific value of the fuel= 43900kJ/kg. Determine the Brake Thermal Efficiency and Brake specific fuel consumption.

Give suitable reasons for the following:

i) Crank shaft speed is double that of cam shaft speed.

ii) Piston rings are an essential component of an internal combustion engine.

iii) Four stroke engines require a heavier flywheel as compared to two stroke engines.

A vapour compression refrigerator uses tetrafluoroethane (R134a) as a refrigerant and operates between 10.1 bar and 2 bar. The vapour is superheated before entering and after exiting the compressor by 7.5$^{0}$C and 18$^{0}$C respectively. Compute the following:

i. Coefficient of performance of the system

ii. Mass flow rate of the refrigerant in the system, if the capacity of the system is 14 TR.
